headline: HMT presents a Polarion-to-SystemVerilog workflow for mixed-signal ASIC verification
fact: At User2User Europe 2026, HMT Microelectronic's Vincent Camus presented a requirement-driven mixed-signal ASIC verification workflow. The public session description connects Siemens Polarion requirements to VIP-based SystemVerilog testbenches, SVA assertions and chip-level mixed-signal validation. It describes automated pass/fail reporting and centralized model hierarchy, simulation configuration and version management. Simulator independence and functional-safety compliance are claims in the presentation description; no third-party certification or quantified verification result was established.
